title: Rare Trees Survey outside Plots (Megantic Only)
author: Sabine St-Jean
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baadiaa6

steps.title: Identify target tree species
steps.instruction: Identify tree species represented by <10 Dominant or Co-dominant individuals across the set of plots at the given site.

substeps.instruction: Export the .csv file from Fulcrum → Vegetation Surveys: Large Trees → [filter: appropriate site].
In Excel, filter the records by species and Crown class.

steps.title: Locate additional individual trees
steps.instruction: Find individual trees ≥ 9 cm DBH outside the plots for the identified species to increase the sample size to at least 10.

substeps.instruction: Use trees recorded at step 8 of the Canopy Trees Survey Protocol - Forests of Southern Québec Protocol if possible.
If not possible, create Plant records for the selected trees following the directions from step 8 of that protocol.

steps.title: Georeference tree locations
steps.instruction: Precisely georeference the tree location using a field cellphone connected to a Trimble GPS.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Update location with GPS' to automatically import Latitude, Longitude, Horizontal Accuracy, and Altitude fields.

steps.title: Record tree measurements
steps.instruction: Record species identification, DBH, height, and crown dimensions using the specified equipment.

substeps.instruction: Use a CAT S41 fieldwork cellphone, Laser Geo, Trimble Catalyst GPS (NTRIP precision subscription), and DP II Caliper and L5 Laser (Art no 15-103-1041 from SYSTEM 2 DP Postex).
Navigate to Plants → Plant Size → Size Measurements.
Refer to the Canopy Trees Survey Protocol - Forests of Southern Québec Protocol for measurement techniques.
Click the Items button and create one new item per measurement.
Save the size measurements and the record.
